plain: A court or panel that hears and judges a dispute

webster.text: Properly, the seat of a judge; the bench on which a judge and his associates sit for administering justice.

more.text: More generally, a court of justice; as, the house of lords in England is the highest tribunal in the kingdom.

example.quote: The hazard in both these respects, could only be avoided, if at all, by rendering that tribunal more numerous than would consist with a reasonable attention to economy.
